title: WPMS/40/2013 of ARVINDERJEET SINGH and OTHERS Vs CONSOLIDATION OFFICER KICHHA and ANOTHER

paras.text:
WPMS No. 40 of 2013
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Heard Mr. Sudhir Kumar, Advocate for
the petitioner, Mr. S.K. Mandal, Advocate for
respondent No. 2 and perused the record.
Learned counsels for the parties submit
that parties have amicably settled the dispute
outside the Court. The parties, who are
present in person in Court along with their
respective counsels, endorsed the statement
made by their counsels.
Sri S.K. Mandal, learned counsel for
respondent No. 2 refers to annexure No. 1 to
the miscellaneous application (CLMA No. 672
of 2019), which is a settlement deed arrived
at between the parties. He further submits
that his client has withdrawn the
recall/restoration application filed before
Consolidation Officer, Kichha, District
Udham Singh Nagar. He further submits
that his client will not claim any right over
the disputed land in future.
In view of the aforesaid statement, the
order dated 12.10.2012 passed by
Consolidation Officer, Kichha, District
Udham Singh Nagar in Case Nos. 526/1993-
94 and 183/11-12 is hereby quashed.
Accordingly, the writ petition is
disposed of.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
28.02.2019
Aswal
